xylophonez-profile.rolling_context: xylophonez's visible public work continues to organize AO/HyperBEAM-adjacent experiments into packaged, testable, and documented forms. In `mystical.computer`, a large commit ported mystical devices to a packaged HyperBEAM layout and added service overlay examples for metered media, paid bundler, and whisper-style services. The same commit added bundler deployment examples, including Caddy and HyperBEAM config examples, making the service setup more reproducible. In `hyperbalance`, local paid whisper compliance flows were expanded with README/docs updates, revised examples, and a new transform example. The practical trajectory is repeatable developer workflows for complex service behavior, especially paid request and bundler-style patterns. This aligns with the broader AO ecosystem movement toward reusable layouts and examples that builders can run locally instead of reverse-engineering.
narrative_threads: experimental AO services are being organized into reusable project structures
paid request and bundler flows are getting clearer docs and local examples
